method: production minified app; local Auth boundary; on-demand RAF

missions.name: First lap
missions.text: Complete one lap of the steam locomotive’s loop.

missions.name: Change tracks
missions.text: Set WX-A or WX-B and drive a locomotive from one loop to another.

missions.name: The long runaround
missions.text: Set the yard switches and drive the shunter along either runaround route.

missions.name: Build a freight train
missions.text: Uncouple a wagon while stopped, then couple it again on the same track.
